notes.subject: לחי/חמור/חמרה
notes.rationale: triple pun: jawbone (lechi) / ass (ḥamor) / heap (ḥamortayim, dual) — the song turns corpse-heaps into an ass-rhyme, fully lost outside Hebrew

notes.subject: חמור חמרתים
notes.rationale: literally 'an ass, two heaps': read as 'heap upon heaps' (KJV) or as pure wordplay 'ass upon asses' (YLT); Bambara keeps the jawbone-parallel and loses the ass/heap echo

notes.subject: kɛmɛ dɔ
notes.rationale: the thousand slain closes the counting motif of vv. 15-16

translation: Shimshon (Sansimɔn) ye fɔ ko: Ni berekɛnin lakodoni ye, lakodoni bɛ lakodoni kan; ni berekɛnin lakodoni ye, ne ye mɔgɔ kɛmɛ dɔ faga.
